title: Repositioning a Contact Center for a New Healthcare Market
summary: FlyPie is a London-based contact center specializing in sales and customer engagement. As the company expanded into healthcare support services, it required a complete digital repositioning to build credibility within the new market. Admonk refined the brand identity and designed a modern, conversion-focused website that communicates professionalism while supporting lead generation and long-term organic growth.

challenge.title: FlyPie was repositioning its business from a traditional contact center into a specialized healthcare support provider.
items: The existing brand identity no longer represented the company's new direction.
The website needed to establish trust within the healthcare sector.
The service offering required clearer positioning and messaging.
Organic visibility needed improvement to attract qualified leads.
The digital experience had to support long-term lead generation.
